newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Placer not raising Highlands offer.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Placer not raising Highlands offer.

text.p: Placer Dome Inc has no plans to raise its 75 cents a share bid for Highlands Gold Ltd, adviser Tony Ferguson of Macquarie Corporate said on Thursday.

Rumours surfaced that the Canadian gold mining giant would raise its A$423.4 million offer following the trade of about nine million Highlands shares, or 1.6 percent of its issued capital, at prices between 76 and 78 cents a share.
Asked if Placer Dome was raising its bid, Ferguson replied: "Absolutely not. Why should we? We have effective control."
Placer Dome bought a 33 percent stake in Highlands before it launched its bid a week ago.
"There is no intention of raising the bid," Ferguson said.
Highlands has rejected the Placer Dome offer, describing it as inadequate and undervaling the company's long-term potential.

Placer Dome also launched a bid for the 24.6 percent of Placer Pacifc Ltd it does not own at the same time it lodged the Highlands offer. If the Canadian miner succeeds with both bids it would control 50 percent of the giant Porgera gold mine in Papua New Guinea, in which both Placer Pacific and Highlands each have a 25 percent stake.
